exit_state: Opening WIP retains past cost and effort under the admitted FIFO or weighted-average policy;abnormal loss is expensed under its separately supported normal-yield facts. Pension recoverability distinguishes refund,contribution reduction and past-service funding. Restoration cash classification follows supplied payment facts and remains conditional.
